<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>NSE IPO progress:</strong> The National Stock Exchange has completed a ₹1,491 crore settlement with SEBI regarding long-pending co-location and dark fibre cases, removing a significant regulatory barrier for its upcoming IPO.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTFBvV245YUdoV1pIb2VLaG9KY1lxa19jSmFwRmptekgyeTl5UGdGU1ZNQVBWZnd1UnFsd21maEFZMktJOTNzQlhVS2dtSFVvOHc4YjlEU2RlemtwTEtFbE13dVJMYzI2WXktczVpb3pjR0NwMXZM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a></span></li>

</ul>
